title: Biographical details: birthplace, maiden name, marriage to Charlie Christian
summary: Allen collects basic facts: born in Mobile, Alabama, maiden name Delk, married Charlie Christian in Chicago on August 20, 1922; he came from Dallas.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: The
Matters that I'm working on. Were you born here in town?
No, I was born in Mobile, Alabama.
Well, that gets us very close to where an awful lot of our people in the music business come from, don't they? And what was your name before marriage?
Lilidel, D-E-L-K.
I see. And you added the Christian after marriage. And when did you marry Mr. Christian?
You were born in Mobile. You want to give me dates? Doesn't matter.
Huh?
You want to give me the dates? March the 12th.
I don't have to give you the year.
All right. Well, I can guess that. But I can't guess accurately. Mobile, Alabama.
Yeah.
And did you marry in Chicago?
Yeah.
1922, what was the date of marriage? Do you remember?
August the 20th.
August the 20th. What's Mr. Christian's first name? Charlie.
Where'd he come from?
Dallas, Texas. Well, how did you happen to get into Chicago?
